cards.name: Kotak NRI Royale Signature Credit Card
cards.evidence: Listing tile 'NRI Royale Signature Credit Card' and NRI menu entry; product page heading 'Apply for Kotak NRI Royale Signature Credit Card'. The resident Royale Signature card (live) is marked 'Discontinued for new applications' but this NRI card is not.

cards.name: Kotak Corporate Gold Credit Card
cards.evidence: Listing tile 'Corporate Gold Credit Card' and Business menu entry; page heading 'Apply for Kotak Corporate Gold Credit Card Online'. No restriction text. [segment: commercial]

cards.name: IndusInd Bank Secured Credit Card (Credit Card Against FD)
cards.evidence: Linked from the IndusInd cards menu as 'Credit Card Against FD' / 'Secured Credit Card' (apply flow on induseasycredit.indusind.bank.in). Not read in detail; fixed-deposit backed.

cards.name: FIRST WOW! Credit Card for NRIs
cards.evidence: Listed under NRI menu ('NRI Credit Card' -> /credit-card/wow/nri-credit-card). Page: 'FIRST WOW! Credit Card for NRIs is fixed-deposit-backed premium credit card' with zero forex markup, needs an IDFC FIRST NRE savings account. Same FIRST WOW! product line restricted to NRIs; may not warrant its own catalogue row.

cards.name: BOBCARD Etihad Guest Premium
cards.evidence: Listed on the BOBCARD card hub and on Bank of Baroda's card page; product page carries Apply Now (etihadguest.bobcard.in). MITC has separate fee rows and a section for it. Separate fee tier from Etihad Guest.

cards.name: BOBCARD Etihad Guest
cards.evidence: Listed on the hub and on Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. MITC and KFS PDFs for it are linked from the MITC page.

cards.name: BOBCARD TIARA
cards.evidence: Listed on the hub, the compare page and Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. Women's credit card, premium category.

cards.name: BOBCARD Cashback
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and compare page and on Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now.

cards.name: BOBCARD Micro Enterprise
cards.evidence: Listed on hub. Product page has no apply button; page says the application must start from the Government of India Jan Samarth portal. Eligibility limited to registered micro enterprises.

cards.name: BOBCARD EMPOWER (Empower Business)
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. For proprietors and self-employed (business card).

cards.name: BOBCARD Uni GoldX
cards.evidence: Listed on hub; product page carries Apply Now; MITC, KFS and T&C PDFs for it are linked from the MITC page.

cards.name: Nainital Bank RENAISSANCE BOBCARD
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and on Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. Page says it is made for Nainital Bank customers.

cards.name: Indian Army YODDHA BOBCARD
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. Exclusively for Indian Army personnel.

cards.name: Indian Navy VARUNAH BOBCARD
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. Exclusively for Indian Navy personnel. Page shows 'Varunah Premium'; MITC has fee rows for both Varunah Premium and Varunah Plus (fee-tier variants).

cards.name: Indian Coast Guard RAKSHAMAH BOBCARD
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. Exclusively for Indian Coast Guard personnel.

cards.name: Assam Rifles The SENTINEL BOBCARD
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and Bank of Baroda's page; product page carries Apply Now. Exclusively for Assam Rifles personnel.

cards.name: PM SVANidhi BOBCARD
cards.evidence: Listed on hub and compare page; page gives a 'Click Here' apply link and says applications start on the PM SVANidhi portal. Only for street vendors who repaid PM SVANidhi loans; MITC/KFS linked on MITC page.

cards.name: Instant RuPay BOBCARD
cards.evidence: Appears only on Bank of Baroda's own credit-card page (lifetime-free RuPay BOBCARD applied for in the bob ePay app: 'Apply on iOS / Apply on Android'). No tile on bobcard.co.in. May be a channel offer of an existing BOBCARD rather than its own product; the page does not say which.

cards.evidence: On the Credit Cards page (fixed-deposit-backed). The page offers an 'Apply now for Pre-approved / Secured Credit Card' link. Variants PDF lists it in the Select/World/Signature tier.

cards.name: Canara RuPay Platinum Secured Credit Card
cards.evidence: On the Credit Cards page (fixed-deposit-backed) with the same 'Apply now for Pre-approved / Secured Credit Card' link.
